'''Gamorrean pilot's boots''' were an item of medium [[Armor/Legends|armor]] [[Boot/Legends|footwear]] designed for [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], worn during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. They were made from a metallic material which was [[Silver/Legends|silver]] in [[Color/Legends|color]]. Whether they were made by the [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Species/Legends|species]] or simply named for them is unknown.
